motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: Small lift and color changes on interactive controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action used for discovery calls and primary next steps.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--dark); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--dark); color: var(--surface); font: 800 0.93rem var(--font-sans); transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 127, 115, 0.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Warm surface container for a service proof point or deliverable.
components.html:
Matching logic

Keys, tolerances and duplicate rules.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 23px; border: 1px solid rgba(21, 32, 29, 0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-card strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; font: 800 1.16rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky compact navigation with an action and bilingual switch.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; color: #3e4946; font: 700 0.92rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 0; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--teal); }

narrative.overview: Marksyte treats data work as something made visible on a shared workbench: calm paper surfaces, dark structural anchors, measured grids and small signals of status. It is analytical without becoming sterile, and practical without becoming generic enterprise UI.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and pale green surfaces
Editorial headlines with mono operational labels
Fine borders, 8px corners and ambient shadows
Responsive grids that collapse into readable flows

rules.name: The Teal-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Use teal to direct action or interpretation, not as a blanket decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use elevation to clarify hierarchy, not to make every section look clickable.

dos: Do make operational outcomes visible in the first viewport.
Do pair editorial statements with concrete deliverables or evidence.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, client logos, metrics or proof claims.
Don't use generic transformation language when a concrete data workflow can be named.
